description: This source file implements the core functions for the ANSC CoVer3 object, including creation, removal, object enrollment, initialization, and shutdown procedures. It defines functions to manage the lifecycle and internal state of the object, and contains licensing and module description headers.

classes.name: ANSC_CO_VER3_OBJECT
classes.description: The main object representing the CoVer3 container, encapsulating lifecycle functions, state variables, locking mechanisms, and task management.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscCoVer3Create(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new ANSC_CO_VER3_OBJECT, setting up function pointers and context handles.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCoVer3Remove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the object, signals shutdown and waits for tasks to complete.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCoVer3EnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls required subordinate objects for operation.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCoVer3Initialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes member variables, function pointers, locks, and internal state variables.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCoVer3Shutdown(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Performs cleanup tasks, releases locks, and prepares object for destruction.
